title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Lake Forest College
description: Ten currently documented food and snack destinations with evening or later availability on campus and in Lake Forest/nearby Highwood.

cards.title: Boomer’s
cards.subtitle: Mohr Student Center, Lake Forest College
cards.notes: Head to the lower level of Mohr Student Center when you need food late; verify any break-period changes before going.
cards.short_summary: Campus food service listed through midnight every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Lake Forest College lists Boomer’s food service until midnight Monday–Friday and noon–midnight Saturday–Sunday during the academic year.
cards.access_notes: Academic-year food service: Mon–Fri 11 a.m.–midnight; Sat–Sun noon–midnight. Limited alcohol service is separately restricted to adults 21+.

cards.title: The Market at Boomer’s
cards.subtitle: Mohr Student Center, Lake Forest College
cards.notes: Use the lower-level market for a late campus snack or drink; check the College dining page during academic breaks.
cards.short_summary: A campus market with midnight academic-year closing.
cards.evidence_claim: Lake Forest College lists The Market at Boomer’s open until midnight daily during the academic year.
cards.access_notes: Academic-year hours: Mon–Fri 8 a.m.–midnight; Sat–Sun 10 a.m.–midnight.

cards.title: Deerpath Cafe
cards.subtitle: Deerpath Hall, North Campus
cards.notes: Stop by Deerpath Hall for a late snack on North Campus; the College lists the cafe as open every day during the academic year.
cards.short_summary: A North Campus snack option scheduled through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Lake Forest College describes Deerpath Cafe as late-night snacks on North Campus and lists it open daily from 8 p.m. to midnight during the academic year.
cards.access_notes: Academic-year hours: seven days a week, 8 p.m.–midnight.

cards.title: Cyber Cafe
cards.subtitle: Donnelley and Lee Library, Lake Forest College
cards.notes: Pair an evening library visit with coffee, juice, fruit, or baked goods; weekday closing is earlier than the midnight campus options.
cards.short_summary: Library-based café open to 10 p.m. on select nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Lake Forest College lists Cyber Cafe on the first floor of Donnelley and Lee Library and gives 10 p.m. closing times Monday–Thursday and Sunday during the academic year.
cards.access_notes: Academic-year hours: Mon–Thu 7:30 a.m.–10 p.m.; Sun 5–10 p.m. Closed Saturday; Friday closes at 2 p.m.

cards.title: The Paw
cards.subtitle: Sports and Recreation Center, Lake Forest College
cards.notes: Pick up a smoothie, sandwich, fruit, or protein shake after recreation-center activities, keeping the listed 9 p.m. weekday close in mind.
cards.short_summary: A recreation-center food counter with weekday evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Lake Forest College says The Paw is on the first floor of the Sports and Recreation Center and lists weekday hours until 9 p.m. during the academic year.
cards.access_notes: Academic-year hours: Mon–Fri 8:30 a.m.–9 p.m.; Sat–Sun 9 a.m.–8 p.m.

cards.title: Oaken Bistro + Bar
cards.subtitle: 200 N Field Drive, Lake Forest
cards.notes: Choose a dinner or takeout stop at the Forester Hotel; its official site lists kitchen service through 10 p.m., separate from the later venue close.
cards.short_summary: A Lake Forest restaurant whose kitchen is listed through 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Oaken Bistro + Bar lists daily hours of 6:30 a.m.–11 p.m. and states that its kitchen closes at 10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Open daily 6:30 a.m.–11 p.m.; kitchen closes at 10 p.m.

cards.entity_name: The Market at The Forester Hotel
cards.title: The Market at The Forester Hotel
cards.subtitle: 200 N Field Drive, Lake Forest
cards.notes: Use the hotel’s grab-and-go market for packaged snacks, salads, pastries, or drinks at any hour; it is a separate destination from Oaken.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 grab-and-go market in Lake Forest.
cards.evidence_claim: The Forester Hotel identifies The Market as a 24/7 grab-and-go market with snacks, salads, pastries, and sweets.
cards.source_title: Eat + Drink at The Forester Hotel | Lake Forest, IL
cards.access_notes: Official hotel dining page lists The Market hours as 24/7.

cards.title: Lou Malnati’s Lake Forest
cards.subtitle: Lake Forest, Illinois
cards.notes: Plan a carryout or delivery pizza order with the location’s day-specific closing times; Friday and Saturday extend to 11 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A Lake Forest carryout and delivery pizza option open until 11 p.m. on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Lou Malnati’s lists its Lake Forest location as carryout and delivery only, closing at 11 p.m. Friday–Saturday and 10 p.m. on other listed days.
cards.access_notes: Tue–Thu and Mon 4–10 p.m.; Fri–Sat 11 a.m.–11 p.m.; Sun 11 a.m.–10 p.m. Carryout and delivery only.

cards.title: The Lantern
cards.subtitle: 768 N Western Avenue, Lake Forest
cards.notes: Use the family restaurant’s kitchen hours for an evening meal; kitchen service ends at 10 p.m., before the separate bar hours.
cards.short_summary: A Lake Forest family restaurant with a kitchen open daily until 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lantern’s official site says it has served families since 1934 and lists its kitchen open every day from 11 a.m. to 10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Kitchen open daily 11 a.m.–10 p.m. The business separately lists bar hours; this card is limited to kitchen service.

cards.title: Froggy’s French Café
cards.subtitle: 306 Green Bay Road, Highwood
cards.notes: For an earlier late-evening dinner in nearby Highwood, check the official reservation page and choose a night with the listed 9 p.m. close.
cards.short_summary: A nearby Highwood restaurant serving dinner until 9 p.m. on its listed nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Froggy’s French Café lists dinner hours of 5–9 p.m. Tuesday–Thursday and Friday–Saturday at its Highwood location.
cards.access_notes: Dinner: Tue–Thu 5–9 p.m.; Fri–Sat 5–9 p.m. Closed Sunday and Monday.
